thread:
Marta: quick design drop — proposing a lightweight 'sidecar' grouping in the left rail for related console panels (logs, alerts, settings). basic goals: fewer top-level items, clearer task flows, preserve deep-linking semantics. link: https://figma.redwood/example-sidecar

Omar: thanks! can you sketch how deep links would work? e.g. if a product page wants to open the sidecar and focus a subpanel, what does the url look like?

Marta: good q. proposal is to add a fragment + query param so routes stay stable: `#/workspace/123/app/overview?panel=sidecar&panel_id=alerts` — opens overview and opens sidecar to alerts. keeps the path canonical for breadcrumbs.

Asha: that pattern seems fine. small frontend nit: we need deterministic focus behavior when `panel` is present. we should avoid hiding content from screen readers when panel toggles. suggest `aria-expanded` on the sidecar trigger and set `aria-controls` to the panel region.

Lee: +1 on the aria attributes. also: when deep-link opens sidecar, ensure focus lands inside the panel on first tabbable element and `aria-current` updates on the corresponding sidebar item. keyboard users should be able to close with `Esc` and return focus to the trigger.

Omar: breadcrumbs question — with the sidecar open, do we show a second-level crumb for the panel? e.g. `Project / App / Overview > Alerts` or keep breadcrumbs only for main path and show panel name as a chip in the header?

Marta: leaning toward keeping breadcrumbs representing canonical path only, and surface the panel as a pill next to the page title (less noise for global nav analytics). but we should prototype both since analytics team cares about count.

Asha: copy tweak: pill text should be verb-first for actions ("View alerts", "Edit settings") — helps with affordance. also microcopy on hover should include keyboard shortcut if any.

Omar: routing edge-case: if a user lands directly at `.../app/overview?panel=sidecar&panel_id=alerts` but the app has permission gating and alerts are disabled, we should fallback to overview and show ephemeral toast: "Alerts not available" rather than a hard error. fallback rules in the router, not component.

Marta: noted — will add fallback policy. also: performance: keep sidecar lazy-loaded (split chunk) but preload when `panel` param present so first paint includes panel UI.

Lee: accessibility test note: include a11y scenarios in the QA checklist — keyboard flow, screen reader announce on open, and focus return on close. I can draft test cases.

NavBot: screenshot job queued for `figma.example/sidecar-v1` — results due in 24h.

Marta: next steps: I'll update the figma and create a tiny RFC with sample URLs, fallback rules, and accessibility checklist. tagging @Omar and @Lee for review. If no objections, we'll schedule a 20min sync tomorrow. :+1:
